mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_question_source WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT qs.*,s.title source_title FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id WHERE qs.question_id IN #{id} ORDER BY qs.question_id,qs.id
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_question_source SET question_id=#{questionId},source_id=#{sourceId},question_no=#{questionNo},page_from=#{pageFrom},page_to=#{pageTo},score=#{score},match_status=#{matchStatus},matched_stem_hash=#{matchedStemHash},evidence_asset_id=#{evidenceAssetId},verification_note=#{verificationNote},verified_at=#{verifiedAt},row_version=row_version+1,update_by=#{updateBy},update_time=NOW(),remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND row_version=#{rowVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_question_source WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND question_no=#{questionNo} AND page_from=#{pageFrom} AND COALESCE(page_to,page_from)=COALESCE(#{pageTo},#{pageFrom}) AND id != #{id}

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(root,id) AS ( SELECT child_question_id,parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE child_question_id IN #{id} UNION DISTINCT SELECT a.root,d.parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN ancestors a ON a.id=d.child_question_id) SELECT a.root descendant_question_id,qs.* FROM ancestors a JOIN kb_question_source qs ON qs.question_id=a.id ORDER BY a.root,qs.id

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(id) AS (SELECT parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation WHERE child_question_id=#{id} UNION DISTINCT SELECT d.parent_question_id FROM kb_question_derivation d JOIN ancestors a ON a.id=d.child_question_id) SELECT qs.* FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN ancestors a ON a.id=qs.question_id

SELECT qs.* FROM kb_question_source qs AND qs.question_id=#{questionId}AND qs.source_id=#{sourceId}AND qs.match_status=#{matchStatus}AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_occurrence_collection c WHERE c.occurrence_id=qs.id AND c.collection_kind=#{collectionKind}) ORDER BY qs.id DESC

SELECT qs.*,s.title AS source_title FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_verified_exam_source e ON e.source_id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE qs.question_id=#{questionId} AND q.content_kind='EXERCISE' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash AND qs.source_id=#{query.sourceId}AND qs.source_id=#{query.examSourceId}AND e.exam_type=#{query.examPurpose}AND e.exam_year=#{query.examYear}AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_source_region rg WHERE rg.source_id=qs.source_id AND rg.region_role='EXAM_SCOPE' AND rg.region_code IN #{code}) ORDER BY qs.id

SELECT qs.*,s.title AS source_title FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_occurrence_collection c ON c.occurrence_id=qs.id AND c.collection_kind='WRONG_QUESTION' WHERE qs.question_id=#{questionId}AND qs.source_id=#{query.wrongSourceId} ORDER BY qs.id

SELECT qs.*,s.title AS source_title FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_verified_exam_source e ON e.source_id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE qs.question_id IN #{questionId} AND q.content_kind='EXERCISE' AND qs.match_status='VERIFIED' AND qs.matched_stem_hash=q.stem_hash AND qs.source_id=#{query.sourceId}AND qs.source_id=#{query.examSourceId}AND e.exam_type=#{query.examPurpose}AND e.exam_year=#{query.examYear}AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM kb_source_region rg WHERE rg.source_id=qs.source_id AND rg.region_role='EXAM_SCOPE' AND rg.region_code IN #{code}) ORDER BY qs.question_id,qs.id

SELECT qs.*,s.title AS source_title FROM kb_question_source qs JOIN kb_source s ON s.id=qs.source_id JOIN kb_occurrence_collection c ON c.occurrence_id=qs.id AND c.collection_kind='WRONG_QUESTION' WHERE qs.question_id IN #{questionId}AND qs.source_id=#{query.wrongSourceId} ORDER BY qs.question_id,qs.id

SELECT qs.id AS occurrenceId,q.id AS questionId,q.title AS questionTitle,q.stem_hash AS stemHash,q.content_kind AS contentKind FROM kb_question_source qs LEFT JOIN kb_question q ON q.id=qs.question_id WHERE qs.id IN #{id}
